children: may retest support at $6,457 a metric ton, a break below which could trigger a fall into the $6,140 to $6,282 range.

A five-wave cycle from $5,760 has completed, with an extended fifth wave. The bottom of wave iv is around $6,140, which serves as a target. A projection analysis on the uptrend from $5,541 marks a higher target of $6,282.
Immediate resistance is at $6,577, a break above which may lead to a gain into $6,656-$6,740 range.
